answer: Lock reputation as collateral: every identity stakes its earned reputation points, not money, and those points are burned if the identity is caught running Sybils. A crystal-clear record takes epochs to build, so a new fake has nothing to stake and earns slowly, while an established agent risks a hard-won standing. A bridge of trust is built point by point, and an onyx-black mark — one confirmed Sybil link — destroys the whole balance. The attacker must choose: build reputation honestly for months, then lose it all in one detection, or stay at zero trust forever.
